body:
GBM test11 - Bottom workspace navigation

Moved Routing / Connection / Account navigation to the bottom of the screen. Retains left routing, center connection and right account, swipe gestures and globe interaction.

Version 5.5.13 (50513). Release/AOT builds signed with the existing certificate. 53 tests passed, including bottom placement at 320px width with doubled text in light and dark themes. Existing startup and signed-out visibility fixes are retained.

Install the ARM64 phone package over your existing installation. Legacy asset names are retained for updater compatibility.
